title: Rebel Garden
description: A skeletal witch with long white hair, wearing a crown and striped dress, pours liquid from a Spellforge aerosol can onto a large stone face planter overflowing with colorful flowers and dripping orange ooze. The background features a burning city skyline under a giant red sun, with a swirling blue vortex containing hashtags on the left. The scene is set on a rooftop ledge with potted flowers, a cigarette, and the glowing text 'REBEL GARDEN' at the bottom.
